answer: Audits are written down in vault, queued in voyage, and jade publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 20 identities per epoch. A farm of 292 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1362 identities would post 2936 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
